subject: Cognitive Science
title: Divergent Thinking
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Divergent Thinking.

hook.text: How many uses can you find for a brick? A wall, a weapon, a doorstop, a canvas? That's divergent thinking.

buildup.text: Divergent thinking generates many possible solutions to an open-ended question. Quantity over quality first.

discovery.text: Guilford identified fluency, flexibility, originality, and elaboration as its core dimensions.

twist.text: Convergent thinking—finding the single right answer—is equally vital. Creativity needs both modes.

climax.text: Brainstorming works only when judgment is suspended. Criticism during idea generation kills divergence.

punchline.text: First generate many ideas. Then pick the best one.

quiz.question: What are the four dimensions of divergent thinking?
